mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM tb_user WHERE created_at >= #{since}

SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed FROM tb_ai_analysis_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}

SELECT provider AS provider_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCESS') AS success, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') AS failed, avg(latency_ms)::float8 AS avg_latency_ms, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens FROM tb_ai_analysis_log WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY provider ORDER BY provider

choose.when: SELECT category AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY category
SELECT sub_type AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY sub_type
SELECT color AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY color
SELECT pattern AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY pattern
SELECT status AS key, count(*) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item GROUP BY status
SELECT s.v AS key, count(DISTINCT i.item_id) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.seasons) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v
SELECT s.v AS key, count(DISTINCT i.item_id) AS count FROM tb_wardrobe_item i CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(i.styles) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL::text AS key, 0::bigint AS count WHERE FALSE

choose.when: SELECT s.v AS key, count(DISTINCT p.profile_id) AS count FROM tb_user_profile p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.colors) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v
SELECT s.v AS key, count(DISTINCT p.profile_id) AS count FROM tb_user_profile p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.moods) AS s(v) GROUP BY s.v
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL::text AS key, 0::bigint AS count WHERE FALSE

where.if: (u.email ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\' OR u.name ILIKE #{q} ESCAPE '\')

mapper.sql: SELECT u.user_id AS id, u.email, u.name, u.role, u.status, u.created_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_wardrobe_item i WHERE i.user_id = u.user_id) AS item_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l WHERE l.user_id = u.user_id AND l.status = 'SUCCESS' AND l.feature = 'ITEM_ANALYZE' AND l.created_at >= #{from} AND l.created_at < #{to}) AS ai_today FROM tb_user u
mapper.select: ORDER BY u.created_at DESC, u.user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT l.ai_analysis_log_id AS id, l.created_at, l.user_id, u.email AS user_email, l.feature, l.provider, l.model, l.status, l.latency_ms, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.image_bytes, l.image_sha256, l.error_code, l.result FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.ai_analysis_log_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id

SELECT l.ai_analysis_log_id AS id, l.created_at, l.user_id, u.email AS user_email, l.feature, l.provider, l.model, l.status, l.latency_ms, l.input_tokens, l.output_tokens, l.image_bytes, l.image_sha256, l.error_code, l.result FROM tb_ai_analysis_log l LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = l.user_id WHERE l.ai_analysis_log_id = #{id}

a.target_type = #{targetType}
